title: Delivery boy at the drugstore for twelve years
summary: He worked twelve years as a delivery boy for a store, paid four dollars a week plus all the ice cream he wanted.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: I worked at a Meister's truck store. What did you do there?
Delivery boy. Delivery boy? How long did you work there?
I worked for him twelve years. Twelve years? Wow. Twelve years. I've seen all his churn raised up. Uh-huh.
How much a week did he get?
Dude, that was a big high pay, huh?
Four hours. Then he could live high.
Four hours. And he'd get the ice cream freezer. Every day.
Every day, you get all the ice cream you wanted? All I could eat. When did you get married, see?
